description: NaCSbO₂F₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaCSbO₂F₃ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. The Na-O bond length is 2.53 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.40 Å. C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) C-O bond length. Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one O and three F atoms. The Sb-O bond length is 2.36 Å. There are a spread of Sb-F bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.06 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one C, and one Sb atom. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Sb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Sb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Sb atom.
